cards.title: What a set is, from last class
cards.purpose: Pull back what a set is before today builds on it: the same five rows as last class, said from memory.
cards.heading: What is a set?

presses.screen: A grid. Rows: <q>Written with</q>, <q>Keeps the order?</q>, <q>Same item twice?</q>, <q>Reach one item by</q>, <q>Can you change it?</q>. Columns: <q>list</q>, <q>tuple</q>, <q>set</q>. The earlier columns are filled; the set column is empty dashed cells.
presses.say: Last class we filled this set column. Say each cell before it shows.

presses.screen: Row 1, <q>Written with</q>: the set cell fills <q>{ }</q>. Beside it, small, the code that proves it and its output: <q><class 'set'></q>.
presses.room: Say the next cell from memory.

presses.screen: Row 2, <q>Keeps the order?</q>: the set cell fills <q>No</q>. Beside it, small, the code that proves it and its output: <q>{'Ravi', 'Sneha', 'Teja', 'Anu', 'Kiran'} / (run it again) / {'Teja', 'Kiran', 'Sneha', 'Anu', 'Ravi'}</q>.
presses.room: Say the next cell from memory.

presses.screen: Row 3, <q>Same item twice?</q>: the set cell fills <q>No</q>. Beside it, small, the code that proves it and its output: <q>2</q>.
presses.room: Say the next cell from memory.

presses.screen: Row 4, <q>Reach one item by</q>: the set cell fills <q>No position. Ask with in</q>. Beside it, small, the code that proves it and its output: <q>True / TypeError: 'set' object is not subscriptable</q>.
presses.room: Say the next cell from memory.

presses.screen: Row 5, <q>Can you change it?</q>: the set cell fills <q>Yes</q>. Beside it, small, the code that proves it and its output: <q>3</q>.
presses.say: That is a set. Today we use it.

cards.interaction: The room says each set cell from memory before it fills.
must: The whole grid, row labels and empty cells, is on the card from press 1. One cell of today's column fills per press.
Earlier columns never change. The room reads today's cell against them.
Each filled cell keeps its proof beside it: the code and its exact output from data.proofs.
must_not: Fill a cell before the room has said it.

change.output: TypeError: 'tuple' object does not support item assignment

reach.output:
True
TypeError: 'set' object is not subscriptable

cards.play: The same grid component as last class, so the room knows it on sight.
